project_comments.note: Cross-cutting observation: CLAUDE.md drift was discovered during WP-005 documentation — the project_summary cross-system dependency row added by WP-004 documentation had not been synced to CLAUDE.md. The file's own header states it is auto-generated from AGENTS.md, but no automation enforces this. Recommend either wiring CTX regeneration into the pre-commit hook or deprecating CLAUDE.md in favour of a direct redirect to AGENTS.md. This is a systemic gap that will recur on every future project that touches AGENTS.md.

outcome_summary: Delivered a two-phase improvement to the GUI project detail page: an immediate CSS/JS fix adding a gradient fade-out and "Show more / Show less" toggle to the .plan-synopsis block (WP-001, WP-003), and a new project_summary data field wired end-to-end through the MCP server schema, storage, tool API, and GUI (WP-002, WP-004). The Ledger Bootstrapper persona was updated to craft and submit a 2–3 sentence project summary during initialization (WP-005), and all impacted manifests, constraints, and cross-system dependency tables were updated to reflect the new field (WP-006). All 6 WPs passed every pipeline stage with zero rework cycles and a final automated test suite of 3,432 passing tests.
